Verify the causal ledger and list its events

Usage: sddk ledger <COMMAND>

Commands:
  verify               Verify sequence continuity, predecessor links, and event hashes
  verify-chain         Verify stream hash chain integrity (Phase 2 SHOULD)
  backfill-chain       Backfill chain_hash for pre-MIGRATION_10 events
  events               List ledger events, optionally scoped to one command frame
  export               Export ledger events as newline-delimited JSON (JSONL) to a file
  replay               Replay events from a named snapshot, optionally verifying chain hashes
  verify-cross-ledger  Verify bidirectional consistency between events_v1 and ledger_events
  watch                Tail the ledger in real time (M9.5 live-mode streaming)
  help                 Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
